nodes.name: ERPNext Stock Webhook
nodes.notes:
Receives webhook from ERPNext when a Stock Entry or Purchase Receipt is submitted. Configure in ERPNext → Settings → Webhook:
- DocType: Stock Entry
- Event: on_submit
- URL: http://n8n:5678/webhook/erpnext-stock-update

nodes.name: Find Medusa Product by SKU
